effective_spec.overview: 模板渲染、Store Port、不可變版本發布與生成生命週期完整候選；C+B方向及已驗收S1保留。

architecture.purpose: M02 converts authenticated immutable M01 definition and separately confirmed design contract into deterministic Program and UiUx generated source artifacts, then publishes an immutable version via one active descriptor. This is generation, not application build/install/release.
architecture.hexagonal: Editor/Test → closed generation commands → DispatchHost GenerationOwner → HOST TemplateGeneration → accepted WORK generation_plan policy. Output ports: authenticated Definition/Approval/Design/Template sources, GenerationArtifactPort and existing FileCommitPort. WindowsGenerationStore adapter implements store/reader coordination; domain has no filesystem/render/framework dependency.
architecture.dependency_map: M01 definition owner → authenticated immutable definition snapshot → M02; M03/M04 single DocumentOwner → explicit saved design capture → M02 typed renderer projection; M02 → immutable source snapshot → M03 preview consumer. No consumer loads arbitrary active paths and no generated code is executed by preview.

ownership.M01: Project UUID, definition/revision and actual definition save. Missing decisions remain Draft/SaveDefinitionOnly; M02 never invents approvalRefs or Defined.
ownership.M02: Prepared generation bytes, preview plans, version manifest, activation proof and operation state. No mutable project definition copy.
ownership.M03/M04: Design content, revision/semantic profile, formal-save proof and single session ownership. M02 only reads authenticated snapshot, never saves/clamps design.
ownership.Store adapter: Safe exclusive stages/sealed tree/readonly snapshot leases; IO owns active journal.
ownership.approval owner: SPEC Approved revision/content-hash authentication, not merely reference strings.
ownership.UI: Review projection and confirmation; cannot supply files/paths/approval booleans.

architecture.mutation: Only GenerationOwner publishes captured bytes through approved Store/IO. M01 definition save and M04 design save are explicit independent operations outside generation; no hidden save-on-generate.
architecture.transactions: Unconfirmed prepare has no storage writes. Confirm revalidates inputs then owned staging → durable no-replace seal → fresh binding check → active descriptor CAS. One active file transaction chooses entire sealed dual-product version. Failure after seal retains unactivated tree; no rollback deletion of old versions.
architecture.approval: C+B direction adopted historically; exact render/store/reader/integration changes below still pending Owner. WORK S1 source/types/tests remain unchanged.
forbidden: template executes expression/shell or package install
S1 Prepared treated as approval authentication
seal existence treated as activation success

source_contracts.definition_port: DefinitionSource.capture(project_binding) -> DefinitionEvidence {typed ProjectDefinition, exact codec bytes, prefixed sha256 digest, revision, owner_generation}; revalidate(evidence) -> Current|Changed|Unavailable. M01 existing adopted S2 owner remains authoritative; new UI/S3 unavailable => DependencyNotReady, no JSON ad-hoc fallback.
source_contracts.approval_port: ApprovalSource.verify(definition_evidence, required_refs[]) -> ApprovalEvidence {sorted approved module/revision/content_hash refs, approval_digest,source_epoch}; every ref must resolve actual Approved immutable SPEC revision with matching raw content_hash. Digest sha256 of compact JSON ["SGA-GENERATION-APPROVAL-v1",sorted tuples]; lowercase sha256: prefix. Unknown/unapproved refs yield missing requirements for S1 SaveDefinitionOnly; integrity mismatch explicit error. Revalidate exact source epoch/content at confirm and activation.
source_contracts.template_port: TemplateSource.read_exact(TemplateReference) -> verified packaged manifest + all source bytes; verify manifest source_digest and each resource digest, target compatibility, exact artifact set, no extra resource/unknown token. No network/template discovery/install script. Bundled template bytes must be sealed reviewed golden, not a name match.
source_contracts.design_port: Capture saved M04 content/profile plus authenticated formal FileCommit +M05 root TransferReceipt +ACK provenance; dirty/deferred proof returns DesignSaveRequired, never save implicitly. Definition/approval/design source reservations held before active writer through receipt.
source_contracts.design_projection: C1/H2 adopted projector turns validated canonical design into closed UI schema (forms/controls/events/data bindings). Unknown nodes/behaviors/invalid bindings unsupported, never silently dropped. Pending bindings remain explicit disabled mock fields and block executable command generation. Material rendering not imported into first template: explicit referenced assets fail UnsupportedDesignFeature until asset export recipe jointly adopted. No props script/event execution.
source_contracts.binding_extension: Existing S1 GenerationBinding unchanged. HOST GenerationInputEnvelope adds design_document_uuid/revision/semantic_profile/digest/formal_proof_digest and renderer_recipe_digest. Preview digest binds S1 plan +all source evidence+exact rendered file hashes. Confirm rechecks both S1 validate_plan_binding and envelope equality; no new WORK field.

stale_window.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
stale_window.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
stale_window.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
stale_window.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
stale_window.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

render_contract.scope: First local-tauri-vanilla1.0.0 template produces reviewed source contracts/behavior skeleton artifacts only, not working business implementation. Preserve two products and all14 declared paths. No build/package/install/launch as generation side effect. Broader target/media/runtime behavior stays unsupported with explicit reason.
render_contract.token_grammar: UTF8 source text scanner accepts only {{TOKEN:CONTEXT}} exactly. TOKEN set PROJECT_UUID, PACKAGE_ID, APP_IDENTIFIER, DISPLAY_NAME, PURPOSE, REQUIREMENTS_JSON, UI_SCHEMA_JSON. CONTEXT enum literal|json|html_text; fixed allowlist per resource. {{ unmatched/unknown token/context or dynamic template_key rejects. No recursive token evaluation: injected text never scanned again. Raw source verified before rendering, output separately bounded.

Embedded JSON lives in separate ui-schema.json fetched as inert data; not inside <script>. Valid Unicode literal, controls escaped; reject lone surrogates/NUL where source contract disallows. No path interpolation.

wire_contracts.common: UTF-8 JSON，無BOM；寫出物用LF結尾。schema/version固定1，unknown keys/duplicate JSON keys/float數字/無效UTF8/trailing bytes拒絕。definition_revision使用canonical decimal string（0..u64MAX），activation_sequence為1..u64MAX，其餘size/count為有界整數。JSON Schema另存schemas/，byte界限與重複keys由語意驗證補足。
wire_contracts.hashes: sha256:＋64小寫hex。template source_digest=已封裝template.json原始bytes之hash（file table含各source檔hash）；不在自身JSON內嵌自己的hash。artifact-manifest digest=其實際序列化bytes；file table不列manifest自身。active descriptor也不含自身digest；base digest由FileCommit讀raw bytes後計算。未改bytes不重新排版；模板檔案內容變動必須改version與digest。
wire_contracts.store_marker: schema=sgenaxis.generation-store,version=1,project_uuid,store_id(32lowerhex)；固定根不存在才建立，不含active/current狀態。
wire_contracts.template_manifest: schema=sgenaxis.generation-template,version=1,template_id,template_version,compatibility{form,platform,language,framework,has_ui},artifacts[{relative_path,product,template_key,source_digest,encoding}]；source檔內容在已授權bundle固定根；不允許commands/install/scripts欄位。
wire_contracts.artifact_manifest: schema=sgenaxis.generation-artifacts,version=1,project_uuid,generation_id,binding{definition_revision,definition_digest,target_id,template_id,template_version,template_digest,approval_digest},files[{relative_path,product,size_bytes,digest}]；files依relative_path ASCII byte升冪，program/ui_ux各至少一筆且與準備plan完全相同。
wire_contracts.activation_descriptor: schema=sgenaxis.generation-activation,version=1,project_uuid,generation_id,activation_sequence(1..u64MAX decimal string),manifest_digest；不儲存任意version_root。根由固定layout＋generation_id組成。序號取前一合法active+1；滿額SequenceOverflow拒絕，原active不變。
wire_contracts.relative_path_grammar: 首尾不能斜線；以/分段，每段1..64 ASCII bytes，僅A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - .；拒.和..、空段、尾點、Windows保留名含副檔名、反斜線/冒號/NUL/UNC/drive/device；整個path≤240且≤16段；ASCII casefold後唯一。檔案表不允許file/dir prefix碰撞。
wire_contracts.template_variables: 只允許declared文字插值，不執行expression。display_name/purpose只能以JSON字串常值或HTML text escaped輸出；Rust identifiers/包識別由UUID衍生ASCII project_<uuid32>與local.sgenaxis.p<uuid32>，不把任意名稱當檔名或程式碼。未知token拒絕；source原始bytes與render後bytes各自界限驗證。
wire_contracts.scope_of_limits: 以上為本次建議預設，不冒稱已採納；Unicode長度以UTF8 bytes另驗，不拿JSON Schema maxLength代替。任何新需求超限須重審，不默默截斷。

store_contract.seal_proof: seal checks every output filename/length/hash, exact table/no extra/missing files, symlink/reparse/hardlink rejection and directory identity. Unknown existing namespace is IdentityMismatch/RecoveryRequired, no takeover. Reader missing sidecar cannot create one; bootstrap happens separately and never under held read lease.
store_contract.rollback: No deletion of sealed versions. abort only exact owned unsealed staging and requires native ownership/containment verification; cancellation/cleanup refusal returns retained diagnostic evidence. Drop closes handles only. No generic recursive project cleanup.
store_contract.reader_output: VerifiedGenerationSnapshot bounded immutable bytes includes generation ID/manifest+each file digest. M03 consumer accepts this snapshot, never resolves path again after lease release. Busy keeps prior verified cache tagged stale, no current proof claim; corrupt/missing/unknown schema stops new load and never repairs automatically.

lifecycle.prepare: Authenticate caller/project then definition/template/approval/design sources; call existing S1 prepare_generation. SaveDefinitionOnly returns missing sorted IDs and no render/store writes; actual definition save delegated M01 explicit command. Prepared renders all exact bytes in memory, checks limits and emits preview plan. No generated root mkdir during prepare.
lifecycle.plan: Server opaque plan_id ASCII1..128 bound actual window instance/project/session/generation, typed definition equality+revision, S1 binding, HOST design envelope, per-file digests and preview digest. TTL60s monotonic, max16plans/runtime, max128MiB rendered-plan memory aggregate; reject capacity, no eviction. Cancel consumes plan only before confirm.
lifecycle.confirm: DTO plan_id+preview_digest+operation_id only. Revalidate sources/fences/S1 binding and base active raw digest. Bootstrap if absent then acquire active writer lease; exact observed bytes digest must equal captured base, sequence+1 checked. Allocate32hex generation ID with exclusive stage create, max32collision attempts. Stage/rendered bytes are the previewed bytes, not re-rendered mutable inputs.
lifecycle.publish: Write+verify owned stage, seal immutable dual tree; revalidate input fences and target identity before activation; replace_checked(base raw,exact active descriptor). Validate CommitReceipt target/previous/committed digest and nonempty transaction_id. Success GenerationActivated carries version+manifest+active raw proof, definition/design capture IDs. M01/M04 baselines never ACKed by M02.
lifecycle.failure: Before active transaction known failure preserves previous active; sealed tree retained as VersionSealedNotActivated. RecoveryRequired/receipt mismatch blocks current publishing/reader truth and retains IO evidence. Once active transaction begins cancel cannot report Cancelled: await actual commit outcome. Valid committed result after owner detach becomes ActivatedDeliveryDeferred, not unchanged failure. No blind retry of active CAS.
lifecycle.replay: Runtime operation cache max128/session1024/runtime; no silent eviction. Same operation/body returns proof; changed body ReplayConflict. Across restart exactly-once not claimed: inspect verified active+manifest by generation/preview binding before manual reconcile; cannot retry lost confirmation to create new activation automatically. New sealed versions retained.
lifecycle.read_refresh: Shared read lease verifies IO terminal state then active/schema/project/sequence; parse manifest and verify exact sealed tree under same lease to immutable bytes. All references in one version, never mix Program/UiUx. Release lease only after snapshot copy. No build or generated-code execution.
lifecycle.design_saved: M04 formal save proof is captured input provenance only. Generating does not mark current design clean, update snapshot baseline or mutate formal file; changed design during render invalidates plan before activation. Later edit after successful activation makes generated version outdated, but historical version/proof stays immutable.
lifecycle.launch_build: Explicit separate future build/package/preview execution scope and approvals. GenerationActivated means source version active only; product_pass stays false, no build/install/native acceptance inference.

errors.precedence: caller/project/closed DTO → owner binding/replay/TTL → exact source authentication → S1 invalid structure/missing decisions → saved-design projection → render/token/output guards → namespace identity → writer lease/base CAS → stage/seal integrity → source fence freshness → active receipt → response delivery. Earliest stage fails, no unrelated IO afterward.
errors.passthrough: Preserve accepted GenerationPlanError field and reason; preserve FileCommitError expected/observed/stage/paths/recovery journal evidence. Native StoreError includes owned stage/sealed version preserved paths on failure; no hidden cleanup success. UI hides unauthorized native paths/source content.
errors.timer_cancel: No automatic generation/timer. TTL uses monotonic clock only; cancel after activation boundary returns operation pending until proof. No automatic retry/package install/template network fetch.

ui.controls: Generate disabled with accessible missing-definition/approval/design-save/template-golden reason. Preview both Program and UiUx file lists, bytes/hashes, input revisions and explicit source-only status; Confirm/Cancel. Active version display separate from Build/Release status. Errors preserve current project/design draft.
ui.ACL: Editor only; Viewer denied all generation commands except trusted internal immutable snapshot consumer. No arbitrary files/source/root/approval boolean fields. Project switch invalidates plans but retains in-flight proof; prior cached snapshot tagged stale if refresh Busy.
ui.integration: M01 finish-review Draft/missing decisions never auto-authorizes render; explicit generation SaveOnly list routed back to owner. M03 receives verified UiUx schema snapshot, uses closed mock capabilities, not generated arbitrary dispatch. M04 controls explicit design save; no legacy FS fallback.
ui.a11y: Keyboard preview/confirm/cancel, focus retained on error; aria-live pending/deferred states; no success badge from sealed-only version.

model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.

model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: This common model and materialized module effective_spec replace only listed fields. Original packages are immutable historical baseline; accepted S1/IO behavior remains unchanged. No Owner adoption inferred from request to prepare revisions.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: project_uuid/document_uuid/session_id/owner_generation/captured_revision/operation_id; UI strings decoded to existing typed IDs/u64; not label authority.

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_types.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
proof_types.TransferReceipt: {issuer:M05,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,root_manifest_ids,external_proof_id,Context,receipt_id}; original Held transitions only after verified durable catalog commit.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.
